import zipfile, re
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
xml = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode()
# pretty print rows/cells
rows = re.findall(r'<row[^>]*>.*?</row>', xml, re.S)
for r in rows:
    cells = re.findall(r'<c ([^>]*)>(.*?)</c>', r, re.S)
    out = []
    for attrs, val in cells:
        ref = re.search(r'r=\"([A-Z]+\d+)\"', attrs)
        t = re.search(r't=\"(\w+)\"', attrs)
        v = re.search(r'<v>(.*?)</v>', val, re.S)
        is_ = re.search(r'<is>.*?<t[^>]*>(.*?)</t>.*?</is>', val, re.S)
        out.append((ref.group(1) if ref else '?', t.group(1) if t else 'n', v.group(1) if v else (is_.group(1) if is_ else '')))
    print(out)
"
